title: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) System for Education Foundation

demo_extraction.scope_summary: Implement finance, HR, payroll and procurement ERP modules. Migrate legacy accounting data and integrate with the provincial treasury system. Provide on-site implementation across nine regional offices.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

eligibility.requirement: Minimum average annual turnover of PKR 40 million over the last three years.
eligibility.source_quote: Minimum average annual turnover of PKR 40 million over the last three years.

eligibility.requirement: The bidder must have been in business for at least 5 years.

eligibility.requirement: Preferred: two public sector ERP implementations
eligibility.source_quote: Prior ERP implementation experience at two public sector organizations is preferred and carries additional marks.

eligibility.requirement: Desirable: SAP or Oracle partner certification
eligibility.source_quote: SAP or Oracle partner certification is desirable.
The bidder should deploy a team of at least 25 full-time technical staff on this assignment.
Affidavit on stamp paper that the bidder has not been blacklisted by any government body.
Bid security in the form of a pay order or bank guarantee shall accompany the financial bid.
